name: pioglitazone
warnings: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Congestive heart failure: Fluid retention may occur and can exacerbate or lead to congestive heart failure. Combination use with insulin and use in congestive heart failure NYHA Class I and II may increase risk. Monitor patients for signs and symptoms. (5.1) Hypoglycemia:
interactions: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Strong CYP2C8 inhibitors (e.g., gemfibrozil) increase pioglitazone concentrations. Limit pioglitazone dose to 15 mg daily. (2.3 , 7.1) CYP2C8 inducers (e.g., rifampin) may decrease pioglitazone concentrations. (7.2) Topiramate may decrease pioglitazone concentrations. ( 7.3 ) 7.1
